Motopropel Technologies.evidence: Motopropel Technologies is an active group company of AKSI Aerospace Group based in India, as documented on the official group website. The company actively designs and develops a range of UAV drone motors and propulsion systems.

UB Motors.evidence: UB Motors is a real entity based in Chennai specializing in the R&D and production of drone motors and integrated ESC systems according to LinkedIn and IndustryMart listings under its parent/associate firm UB Associates.
